easyPrerequisites:
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
You have at least two cards in hand.
description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Jolrael
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers three times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first and second Springheart Nantuko triggers, choosing not to pay and creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the third Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
